name: idunworks-skills
description: Claude Code skills drawn from features built on idunworks.com. Each says on its own page when it runs, and none of them publishes anything.

plugins.name: session-to-blog
plugins.description: Turn a finished piece of work from a Claude session into a redacted, first-person blog post draft. Runs only when you call /session-to-blog, and never publishes.

plugins.name: not-the-product
plugins.description: Review a community or social app feature so its members are never the product, and write the plain-language promises that say so, each backed by a test or a guard. Runs when you design or review community features; never publishes or changes anything on its own.

plugins.name: not-generic
plugins.description: Review a finished text or web page for generic, unsupported, repetitive or unconsidered work, and name a concrete change for each finding. Runs only when you call /not-generic, and changes nothing on its own.
